让我先查看 `VersionSelect.astro` 的代码，了解版本选择的实现方式： 我找到问题了！在 `initVersionSelect` 函数中，代码确实尝试从 `state.destylerVersion` 恢复版本，但问题是：

1. `selectedVersion` 默认值是 `'latest'`
2. 在 `setTimeout` 中读取 `state.destylerVersion`，但只有当它不是 `'latest'` 时才更新
3. 然而，`updateUI` 只是显示 `selectedVersion` 的值，但如果版本还没从 URL 加载完成，就会显示 `latest`

让我检查一下 URL 状态恢复的逻辑： 让我查看 `playground.ts` 中 URL 恢复时是如何传递版本信息的： 我看到 `url:framework-restored` 事件中确实传递了 `destylerVersion`。问题在于 `VersionSelect.astro` 的初始化逻辑。

让我看看 state 是如何定义的： 现在我理解问题了。问题出在 `VersionSelect.astro` 的初始化流程：

1. 页面加载时，`initVersionSelect` 在 `setTimeout 150ms` 后从 `state.destylerVersion` 读取版本
2. 但是 `url:framework-restored` 事件在 `100ms` 后才触发
3. 两者时序不确定，可能导致版本没有正确显示

更重要的是，问题在于：当从 URL 恢复版本时，`loadVersionsForFramework` 函数会**重置** `selectedVersion = 'latest'`，这会覆盖掉之前恢复的版本。

让我修复这个问题： 现在让我也更新初始化部分，确保在页面加载时也能正确显示从 URL 恢复的版本： 初始化代码看起来是对的，但 150ms 的延迟可能不够。让我看看 `playground.ts` 中的时序设置： 问题确认：`URL_RESTORE` 延迟是 100ms，而 VersionSelect 的初始化是 150ms。理论上应该是对的，但实际上可能有竞争条件。

主要问题是：

  "content": "&#96;&#96;&#96;astro\nfunction initFrameworkSelect() {\n  const { trigger, container } = getElements()\n\n  if (!trigger || !container) return\n\n  // Prevent double initialization\n  if ((container as any).__initialized) {\n    return\n  }\n  (container as any).__initialized = true\n\n  // Initial render\n  renderFrameworkList()\n\n  trigger.addEventListener('click', (e) =&gt; {\n    e.stopPropagation()\n    toggle()\n  })\n\n  window.addEventListener('click', handleClickOutside)\n  window.addEventListener('blur', handleBlur)\n  window.addEventListener(EVENTS.URL_FRAMEWORK_RESTORED, handleUrlStateRestore)\n\n  // Listen for playground state ready event\n  window.addEventListener(EVENTS.PLAYGROUND_STATE_READY, (e: Event) =&gt; {\n    const customEvent = e as CustomEvent&lt;{ framework: Framework }&gt;\n    const framework = customEvent.detail.framework\n    if (framework &amp;&amp; selectedFramework !== framework) {\n      isInitializing = true\n      selectedFramework = framework\n      updateUI()\n      renderFrameworkList()\n      isInitializing = false\n    }\n  })\n\n  // Sync from state with retries\n  function syncFromState() {\n    if (state.activeFramework &amp;&amp; selectedFramework !== state.activeFramework) {\n      selectedFramework = state.activeFramework\n      updateUI()\n      renderFrameworkList()\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Try multiple times to handle timing\n  syncFromState()\n  setTimeout(syncFromState, 100)\n  setTimeout(syncFromState, 300)\n  setTimeout(syncFromState, 600)\n\n  // Mark initialization as complete after delays\n  setTimeout(() =&gt; {\n    isInitializing = false\n  }, INIT_DELAY)\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n",
  "textEditContent": "function initFrameworkSelect() {\n  const { trigger, container } = getElements()\n\n  if (!trigger || !container) return\n\n  // Prevent double initialization\n  if ((container as any).__initialized) {\n    return\n  }\n  (container as any).__initialized = true\n\n  // Initial render\n  renderFrameworkList()\n\n  trigger.addEventListener('click', (e) =&gt; {\n    e.stopPropagation()\n    toggle()\n  })\n\n  window.addEventListener('click', handleClickOutside)\n  window.addEventListener('blur', handleBlur)\n  window.addEventListener(EVENTS.URL_FRAMEWORK_RESTORED, handleUrlStateRestore)\n\n  // Listen for playground state ready event\n  window.addEventListener(EVENTS.PLAYGROUND_STATE_READY, (e: Event) =&gt; {\n    const customEvent = e as CustomEvent&lt;{ framework: Framework }&gt;\n    const framework = customEvent.detail.framework\n    if (framework &amp;&amp; selectedFramework !== framework) {\n      isInitializing = true\n      selectedFramework = framework\n      updateUI()\n      renderFrameworkList()\n      isInitializing = false\n    }\n  })\n\n  // Sync from state with retries\n  function syncFromState() {\n    if (state.activeFramework &amp;&amp; selectedFramework !== state.activeFramework) {\n      selectedFramework = state.activeFramework\n      updateUI()\n      renderFrameworkList()\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Try multiple times to handle timing\n  syncFromState()\n  setTimeout(syncFromState, 100)\n  setTimeout(syncFromState, 300)\n  setTimeout(syncFromState, 600)\n\n  // Mark initialization as complete after delays\n  setTimeout(() =&gt; {\n    isInitializing = false\n  }, INIT_DELAY)\n}",
